name: William Paterson University of New Jersey

ipeds.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - William Paterson University of New Jersey (fall 2024 admissions and enrollment)

ipeds_api.title: NCES IPEDS fall 2024 admissions counts and nonresident-alien undergraduates (Urban Institute Education Data Portal)

stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024). Exact counts come from the NCES admissions file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal; College Navigator shows 90% admitted and 13% of admits enrolled. There is no usable Common Data Set: the university's Common Data Set page lists nothing newer than 2021-22, so GPA, international applicants and admits and admission factors are not shown. IPEDS shows only 2 enrolled first-years (0%) sending SAT scores, so SAT/ACT percentiles are not published; William Paterson is test-optional. Undergraduate enrollment of 6,647 and 172 nonresident-alien undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2024 figures (College Navigator and Urban Institute Education Data Portal).

cds_test_policy.notes: Admissions pages say SAT/ACT scores are optional for most majors; scores can help for Nursing, merit scholarships and the Honors College.
